notes.title: V1.0 Now Live For All Pre-Release owners!
notes.notes:
Howdy, Scrumlords! The day of [strike]reckoning[/strike] release is nearly upon us, and our team has been working pounding out the final details and quashing a fine few bugs along the way. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44424026/80f364b719252a176bfcd11a82817f88e3405f85.png[/img]

[h2]Version 1.0 Patch Notes : [/h2]

[list]
[*] Numerous VFX Optimizations
[*] Enemy spawn optimizations
[*] Damage number spawn optimizations
[*] Improved transitions between levels
[*] Improved transitions from main menu to campaign and vice versa
[*] Archers no longer get swept up by the enemy mob and pushed endlessly towards the player
[*] Added new graphics for the "Door" to next level with cute lil' flag waving guys
[*] Adjusted stat balancing during tutorial
[*] Fixed: UI issues in tutorial
[*] Fixed: Special enemies spawning at incorrect times
[*] Fixed: Error where game over screen would display sum of enemies defeated across multiple campaigns
[*] Devs responsible for the above errors have been identified, chided, and thrown into the oubliette
[/list]

See you at launch next Tuesday, August 29!

notes.title: Update V. 0.9 : New Enemies
notes.notes:
Hello, Scrumlords! V 0.9 is out with a host of new features and improvements. Some highlights include:

[list]
[*] Added three new enemy types 
[*] Added one new weapon
[*] New Character VFX for player and enemies
[*] Optimized enemy spawn behavior
[*] Improved random level generation
[*] Added a Low Graphics setting to main menu
[*] Improved Main Menu visuals
[*] Hotfixed [strike]all[/strike] a great number of bugs created by adding aforementioned features
[/list]

We hope you like it!
